description: This file declares the em_cmd_cli_t class, which extends em_cmd_exec_t, providing methods for retrieving network node information, executing commands, and managing socket addresses within a mesh network command-line interface context. It also references external structures and variables related to network communication.

classes.name: em_cmd_cli_t
classes.description: A class extending em_cmd_exec_t, providing CLI command functionalities for network node management and command execution within a mesh network.

methods.name: struct:sockaddr_in * get_ep_addr()
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the sockaddr_in structure representing the control address.

methods.name: get_edited_node
methods.description: Fetches the details of the edited network node based on a header identifier.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a command and stores the result in the provided buffer.

methods.name: em_cmd_cli_t
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CLI command class with a reference to an em_cmd_t object and network address.

methods.name: ~em_cmd_cli_t
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources used by the class instance.
